# chakra-ui-solid

> An unofficial SolidJS port of Chakra UI, the component system for building SaaS products with speed. 

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/fabien-ml/chakra-ui-solid): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://chakra-ui-solid.pages.dev/): Official website and documentation.
